title: ADmod confirmatory evaluation protocol (IEEE Access revision)
status: frozen before any confirmatory model was trained and before any confirmatory cohort was generated

training_data.note: Same training and validation subjects as medRxiv v2. Validation is used for checkpoint selection and the ridge penalty only.

exploratory_note: These sets were seen during development of ADmod and the baselines. Results on them are exploratory and are never used for confirmatory claims.

variants.ax_plain: Plain 3D U-Net: same backbone and gap channels; no global context, no region maps, no coordinates, direct head
variants.ax_no_gap: ADmod without gap channels and without gap input to the global MLP (two-head output still scales by the gap)
variants.ax_no_global: ADmod without the global context MLP
variants.ax_one_scan: ADmod given the baseline scan only
variants.ax_direct: ADmod with one correction head instead of fix + gap x rate

training_policy.schedule: cosine annealing to zero over 100 epochs
training_policy.precision: bfloat16 autocast for training, float32 for all evaluation

deep_models.deep_model_score: each metric is computed per seed and averaged over the 3 seeds

baselines.ridge_lambda_selection: highest regional change R^2 on data/val.npz

primary_endpoint.name: regional change R^2 against the measured follow-up
primary_endpoint.definition: Pool the predicted and measured baseline-to-follow-up change of every cortical region of every subject; R^2 = 1 - SSE / SST over that pool.
primary_endpoint.inference: B = 10000 paired subject-bootstrap resamples (seed 2027), the same resample for both methods. One-sided p = (1 + #{Delta*_b <= delta0}) / (B + 1).
primary_endpoint.family: Holm step-down over P1-P4, one-sided alpha = 0.025

ablation_family.inference: same paired bootstrap; two-sided p = min(1, 2 min(P*(Delta <= 0), P*(Delta >= 0))) with the +1 correction
ablation_family.family: Holm step-down over the 6 comparisons, two-sided alpha = 0.05
ablation_family.note: ax_full vs ax_plain also appears as P2; inside this family it is tested two-sided.

secondary_descriptive: All methods on C1, C2, C3: regional change R^2, voxel change R^2, composite MAE, RMSE to the noise-free follow-up, with 95% bootstrap CIs
Paired Wilcoxon signed-rank test on per-subject squared regional-change error for every primary comparison
Fraction of subjects with lower error than each comparator
Regional change R^2 by forecast gap: 1-2, 2-3, 3-4 years (C1) and 6-8 years (C3)
Noise ceiling: the noise-free follow-up scored against the measured follow-up
Training time per model and inference time per subject

sensitivity_descriptive.models: ax_full retrained with seed 0 under the same policy for each setting; baselines refit; ridge lambda chosen on the setting's validation split
sensitivity_descriptive.split: 240-subject training cohort split 210 train / 30 validation by subject; separate 120-subject test cohort

deviations: Any change to this protocol after freezing is listed in protocol/DEVIATIONS.md and reported in the paper.
